prompt: You are on a train with no signal and no model configured. Which of these still works?
options: Reading a lesson, playing its activities, and answering a test the app marks itself
Only reading: every question needs a model
Nothing: the app checks for a model at startup
Everything except building a new course
explanation: Most questions are answered by comparison inside the app, instantly and offline. A model is needed to build a course, to answer the tutor, and to mark a question that has to be read rather than compared.
